name: Industrial-organizational psychologist
description: Manages change (APQC 13.4): plans each change with the people and processes it touches, designs how it lands, follows its rollout and checks the improvement holds.

onet.title: Industrial-Organizational Psychologists
onet.basis: APQC 13.4 is planning, designing, implementing and sustaining organizational change, and organizational development and analysis is in O*NET's description of industrial-organizational psychologists; chosen over the --complete suggestions, which share only the word change. Management analysts also fit, so a person should confirm.
onet.by: agent, EE-251 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: Who does the change touch, and what must each of them do differently?
Did the improvement hold after the change landed?
